run_type: Two fresh-boot, opposite-order source comparisons of the check-only field and visibility-table change.
readout: Primary outcome: retired user instructions for the complete ordinary cargo check -p ty_server --lib on historical Ruff #27470, including all descendants. The earlier parent profile supplies an upper bound; it is excluded from the paired effect.

Enroll both PC and CP boots before seeing costs. Each role must run the signed, locked project, both zero-compiler noops, the real edit and its repair, empty-state build, and a failing E0308. Require exact target inventory and successful warm/clean verdicts. Before a performance claim, independently reopen native counters, actual rustc argv and metadata. Publish every enrolled outcome, including refusals.

Separately widen Origin.path in the real dependency and add a consumer in ruff_db. Narrow just the dependency, keeping both the valid consumer and build directory. Both rustcs must give exactly E0616 at the same access incrementally and with empty build state. Rewidening must compile. All privacy controls run after the counted historical workload.

Advance to independent confirmation if both pilots save at least 10% on the whole edit and skip at least one indirect rustc. The target is at least 20% fewer instructions or an actual 2x on a historical workflow. Compare cold and both noops. Investigate a reproducible cold cost above 1% before publication.

Confirmation design: eight new independent paired boots, four PC and four CP. Primary decision uses each boot once. Report both raw arms, each ratio, median reduction and a distribution-free median interval using the observed extremes (99.2% coverage for independent paired hosts). For a 2x claim the slowest qualifying ratio C/P must be at most 0.5. Keep both pilots separate from confirmation.

If the factory or an on-host correctness or provenance check fails, retain that result. Repair only an identifiable infrastructure bug before a new enrolled acquisition. A valid check with the original roster or a missed performance target is a result.
